Battlefield 6 is an upcoming first-person shooter game developed by DICE under the collective branding of Battlefield Studios, and published by Electronic Arts. Serving as the eighteenth installment in the Battlefield series, after Battlefield 2042, the game will release on October 10, 2025 on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S and Microsoft Windows.
Marketing
On February 3, 2025, Electronic Arts announced an initiative titled Battlefield Labs, a closed-access worldwide playtest for an upcoming installment in the Battlefield series. The reveal confirmed that the game was being developed by DICE under the collective branding of Battlefield Studios. Before its closure in 2024, Ridgeline Games was also involved in the development, focusing on the single-player campaign. The announcement video featured gameplay from a pre-alpha build of Battlefield 6 and also confirmed the game's modern warfare setting. By March 2025, early gameplay footage from Battlefield Labs had been leaked online by playtesters.
On July 19, 2025, the game's title was leaked early when Electronic Arts sent packages to influencers featuring the Battlefield 6 logo. On July 21, Battlefield Studios announced that the upcoming title would have an open beta prior to its official release.
The game was officially revealed as Battlefield 6 on July 22, 2025, when Electronic Arts announced the premiere date for the official reveal trailer, which was released on July 24, 2025.
On July 23, 2025, an additional teaser was published on the Battlefield social media pages. The teaser indicated that the central conflict would involve NATO and a private military company named Pax Armata.
Release
Battlefield 6 is scheduled for release on October 10, 2025, on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S and Microsoft Windows via Steam and the Epic Games Store. On all platforms, the base game will retail at USD$69.99 and a special "Phantom Edition" will retail at USD$99.99.
